meta.title: Media skin
meta.description: Whole window, or split with separate images for the content area and the left sidebar. Each layer has its own cropper — drag to frame it, scroll to zoom, and the preview frame is exactly what lands. No more fixed fit / position / zoom presets. Each layer also keeps its own blur, media opacity, brightness, saturation and contrast: click a media card to switch which layer the sliders edit, so there is still only one set of sliders, and one "Copy look to ..." button pushes the whole set to the other layer in split mode. Blur never enlarges the picture — the framing stays put. Media is uploaded only — no local-path input cluttering the panel. The panel is frosted glass, and the corner button is the plugin's own whale-chef avatar.
